faq_heading: Langley houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Langley house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 187 houses with a legal suite that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $1,580,000, with the middle half between $1,450,000 and $1,927,500. Every Langley detached house had a median of $1,378,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Langley?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 187 Langley houses sold with a legal suite and 139 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,402,500.

faq.q: Who must live on the lot with a suite in the City of Langley?
faq.a: The registered owner. Bylaw No. 3300 also asks for one extra off-street parking space and records approved suites in the City’s registry.

faq.q: How large can a Township of Langley suite be?
faq.a: Up to 120 square metres of gross floor area, with one suite allowed for each principal dwelling unit and a building permit required for every suite.

faq.q: Which Langley neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Willoughby Heights had 104 legal-suite sales, Brookswood Langley 24 and Aldergrove Langley 13 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Langley houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 29 days at a median, closing at 96.6% of list, with 5% over the list price.

This search lists detached houses for sale in the City and Township of Langley that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Willoughby Heights (194), Walnut Grove (137), Brookswood Langley (112), Langley City (105) and Aldergrove Langley (95). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 777 detached houses that sold in Langley between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 326 (42%) had a suite: 187 legal and 139 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,580,000, 15% more than the $1,378,000 median for every Langley house.

It has 3,708 square feet of floor area, against 2,614. 94% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 45% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,734 square feet and a median $1,402,500.

Alongside suites, 23 Langley houses had lane access, at a median of $1,445,000; 14 were marked as a coach or laneway house at $2,762,500; 3 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: “Langley” is two municipalities with different suite rules. The City of Langley’s Bylaw No. 3300 limits a secondary suite to the lesser of 100 square metres and 40% of the building’s gross floor area, wants the owner living on the lot and one extra off-street parking space, and requires an inspection, a building permit and an entry in the City’s secondary suites registry.

The Township of Langley’s Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, section 102, caps a suite at 120 square metres of gross floor area and allows one for each principal dwelling unit, with a building permit for every suite. Willoughby listings often call a suite legal, so ask for the permit rather than relying on the word.

Zoning Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024, brought small-scale multi-unit housing to the Township, with 3 to 4 units on eligible lots and no 6-unit tier. The Township estimated about 55% of its single-family and duplex lots, roughly 15,000 properties, would qualify.
The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Langley was $1,448,100 in October 2026, 6.5% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a Langley house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Langley permit and final inspection for the suite. 139 of the 326 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Find out which municipality the house is in before you read the suite rules. The City of Langley keeps a registry of secondary suites, so ask whether this one is recorded in it.

Measure the suite against the limit of the City’s lesser of 100 square metres (1,076 square feet) and 40%, or the Township’s 120 square metres (1,292 square feet), and ask for the floor plan that was approved with the permit.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 29 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,402,500 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,580,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
